summary: Opus review of the M3 diff (706a001..HEAD): 0 Critical, 2 Important, 9 Minor; no second round. Fixed both Important (a Gotchas line carries a fact in any case/markup/wrap; `resolved` dismisses a promoted fact) and 7 Minor RED→GREEN; docs and the three M3 decision files updated. Tests 451 → 455.
verified_how: Each new check was watched failing, then passing: `entries.mjs: a Gotchas line carries a fact in any case or markup, resolved dismisses a fact or a question as context.md shows it` (Important 1, 2; Minor 3, 4), `gotchasLines: a wrapped bullet is one line and any # or ## heading ends the section` (1, 6), `entries.mjs pack: an unreadable CLAUDE.md leaves the Gotchas out, never the pack` (5), `memlint: currentRules skips ranges written with any dash or to, and a heading never replaces a row` (7; old memlint gives d.md:13,9,5,3,1). All 7 ~/projects/*/docs/decisions.md give the same currentRules output before and after (md5). bash -n on driver.sh, prompt.sh, stub-claude.sh, checks 12 and 38; node --check on entries.mjs and memlint.mjs. Full suite: check.sh green in 257 s, 455 tests.

discoveries.text: memlint gotchasLines now joins an indented continuation line onto its bullet and ends the section at a `# ` heading too; entries.mjs pack matches a promoted fact to a Gotchas line by its first 40 characters lowercased with backticks, * and _ removed (key/loose in pack).
currentRules: a heading never replaces a bullet or table row of the same D<n>, and D1—D6 / D1 – D6 / D1 to D6 are group headings; M4's lint can reuse the same id regex.

proposed_changes: The debrief (lib/debrief.sh:124) still lists questions a later entry resolved; it could skip them now that progress.md renders `Resolved:` items (review finding 4, left).
